text:
AIC is looking for a new group moderator to join the team!

If you want to make a real impact and help hundreds of international couples, and you are: 
1. Super familiar with the partner immigration process to Israel, as well as other bureaucratic aspects
2. Always scrolling on Facebook
3. Have great English (Hebrew is a plus!)
4. Patient and willing to learn new things 
Your place is with us! 

Please send us a PM with some information about yourself and why you'd like to volunteer as a group moderator, and we'll be in touch! 💙
